maria_fin: Quick heads-up — Sales requested a retroactive proration + FX adjustment for HelioWorks (INV-7832). They migrated SKUs mid-cycle but were billed full month on the old SKU; sales asking for a one-time credit and reissue in EUR.
josh_sales: Confirmed with the customer. Migration happened 2026-02-12 (mid-cycle). Old SKU rate = €0.12/token, new SKU = €0.09/token. They want proration + a loyalty concession (sales proposes an extra 10-15%).
amira_cs: Customer is a small EMEA enterprise, high churn risk if we don't accommodate. Migration delay was on our side (regional infra rollout), they were promised smoother cutover.
maria_fin: Quick numbers so we're aligned: original invoice = €61,728. Proposed approach: compute proration delta for days on old SKU, then apply one-time goodwill discount on that delta. Because this is >€10k, need deal-desk approval and finance lead sign-off. Also need to reissue in EUR (invoice originally USD).
sam_ops: We can re-issue in EUR and update accounting entries. Need to verify whether any quantity caps or SKU mapping rules will block automated proration in billing system - tagging @legal if T&C changes required.
josh_sales: Sales asks for approval to apply a 15% one-time discount on the proration delta (not on whole invoice) + reissue EUR invoice. This is to keep the account in pilot and avoid churn.
maria_fin: Here's the working calc (rounded):
```
old_charge = 61728
days_on_old = 12
prorated_old = old_charge * (days_on_old/30) = 61728 * 0.4 = 24691.2
expected_new_charge_for_same_period = usage_at_new_rate ≈ 15433.2
proration_credit = prorated_old - expected_new_charge_for_same_period = 9258
one_time_discount = proration_credit * 0.15 = 1388.7
total_credit = proration_credit + one_time_discount ≈ 10646.7 (~€10,647)
```
Note: using 30-day month for simplicity per billing calc; exact cents to be reconciled by accounting.
maria_fin: Requesting deal-desk approval: one-time credit ≈ €10,647 (proration + 15% concession) and reissue invoice INV-7832 in EUR. Rationale: retention, migration disruption on our side, pilot concession.
leo_cfo: Reviewed. Approve up to €11,000 one-time credit and EUR reissue. Please include notation on the credit memo referencing "pilot migration concession" and BA ticket. @maria_fin, proceed. ✅
dealbot: Approval recorded — Deal Desk approval granted by leo_cfo for thread 2214567890. Action created: finance_adjustment BA-4421.
josh_sales: Great, thanks all 👏 I'll notify the customer once the credit memo is sent and update the renewal owner.
amira_cs: I'll update the CRM (account note + churn risk cleared) and track NPS follow-up. Can someone confirm ledger code? Prefer `billing:prorations` so reporting spikes correctly.
maria_fin: I'll create the credit memo, set GL code to billing:prorations, attach reconciliation to BA-4421, and reissue invoice in EUR. Closing when BA-4421 settled. 👍
